title: Text-free tutorial step
prompt_en: Vertical 9:16 top-down shot of hands folding a paper crane on a white table. Each fold is crisp and deliberate. Even soft-box lighting, minimal shadows, neutral colors, camera locked overhead.
prompt_zh: 竖屏 9:16 俯拍，双手在白色桌面上折纸鹤。每一折都干脆利落。均匀柔光箱照明，阴影很少，中性色调，镜头固定在正上方。
why_it_works: Overhead locked framing keeps hands readable and is a reliable format for how-to shorts without needing on-screen text.
